name: Void Rift
description: A jagged tear in reality bleeds violet light, dragging shreds of matter into the dark
preview_html:
<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>*{margin:0;padding:0}body{overflow:hidden}canvas{display:block}</style></head><body><script src="../../vendor/three.min.js"></script><script>(function(){
var W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;
var renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(W,H);renderer.setClearColor(0x060310);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
var scene=new THREE.Scene();
var camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55,W/H,0.1,100);
camera.position.set(0,0.5,4);camera.lookAt(0,0.4,0);
function ADD(m){scene.add(m);return m;}
function GLOW(c,o){return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:c,transparent:true,opacity:o,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false});}
function SOLID(c){return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:c});}
function PTS(n,size,extra){var p=new Float32Array(n*3),c=new Float32Array(n*3),g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(p,3));g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(c,3));var m=new THREE.PointsMaterial(Object.assign({size:size,vertexColors:true,transparent:true,opacity:0.9,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false},extra||{}));var pts=ADD(new THREE.Points(g,m));return {p:p,c:c,g:g,m:m,pts:pts,up:function(){g.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;g.attributes.color.needsUpdate=true;}};}
function BOLT(seg,col,op){var arr=new Float32Array((seg+1)*3),g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr,3));var ln=ADD(new THREE.Line(g,new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:col,transparent:true,opacity:op,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false})));return {ln:ln,arr:arr,seg:seg};}
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;renderer.setSize(W,H);camera.aspect=W/H;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();});

var VC=0xb040ff;
var glow=ADD(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.62,32),GLOW(VC,0.35)));glow.scale.set(0.6,1.75,1);glow.position.y=0.4;
var slit=ADD(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.07,2.7),GLOW(0xf0d0ff,0.6)));slit.position.set(0,0.4,0.01);
var edgeL=BOLT(12,0xe0a0ff,0.9),edgeR=BOLT(12,0xe0a0ff,0.9);
function edge(b,sgn){for(var k=0;k<=12;k++){var f=k/12,yy=0.4+(f-0.5)*3.0,w=Math.sin(f*Math.PI)*0.32;b.arr[k*3]=sgn*(w+(Math.random()-0.5)*0.05);b.arr[k*3+1]=yy;b.arr[k*3+2]=0.02;}b.ln.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;}
var N=130,S=PTS(N,0.06),pa=new Float32Array(N),pr=new Float32Array(N),py=new Float32Array(N);
function seed(i){pa[i]=Math.random()*6.283;pr[i]=0.6+Math.random()*1.5;py[i]=0.4+(Math.random()-0.5)*2.6;var w=Math.random()<0.35;S.c[i*3]=w?0.9:0.6;S.c[i*3+1]=w?0.6:0.25;S.c[i*3+2]=1;}
for(var i=0;i<N;i++)seed(i);
var t=0,ej=0;function animate(){requestAnimationFrame(animate);t+=0.02;ej--;if(ej<=0){ej=2+(Math.random()*3|0);edge(edgeL,-1);edge(edgeR,1);}
  glow.material.opacity=0.28+0.14*Math.sin(t*5);slit.scale.x=1+0.4*Math.sin(t*7);slit.material.opacity=0.5+0.3*Math.abs(Math.sin(t*6));
  for(var i=0;i<N;i++){pr[i]-=0.012;pa[i]+=0.05;if(pr[i]<=0.15)seed(i);var r=pr[i];S.p[i*3]=Math.cos(pa[i])*r*0.55;S.p[i*3+1]=py[i]+Math.sin(pa[i])*r*0.15;S.p[i*3+2]=Math.sin(pa[i])*r*0.55;}
  S.g.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;
  renderer.render(scene,camera);}
animate();})();</script></body></html>
